# Direct seeds with an unbounded carrier slot

An independently authored static factory retains one direct Object formal, one
invariant unary operator and a three-slot result with the same formal in its
first/last slots and an unbounded middle slot. Its opaque late-selected carrier
predicts neither an operator invocation nor a returned-seed identity. An inherited
facade and reversed parameter order preserve the original target and inputs.

The owned program also calls the real SDK Collectors.reducing overload. Its
collector is driven only by the owned observer; nullable inputs, fresh supplier
state, accumulator/combiner operand identities, opaque results and exact partial
failures stay observable. Source and SDK profiles compile every Java8 unit and
retain definitions, roles, Signatures, Exceptions and helpers. Wrong programs
precede recovery and metadata controls preserve Code.
